status: BOUNDED SC AUTHORITY EVIDENCE / NOT A NEW RULE OR SERVICE BUILD COMMISSION

authority.finding: Service Case Approver approves each formal repair/replacement/charge/customer-movement decision before execution; routine unchanged approved-scope follow-up does not repeat approval; Service approval does not bypass Purchasing/Stock/Delivery permissions.
SC MPR links an existing Case and its files. Purchasing retains its separate request approval/issue authority, exact scope and changed-source revalidation. No serviceDecisionId field is prescribed.
Service overall Blueprint/application build remains incomplete and not commissioned by this Purchasing task.

existing_representations.representation: carres_action / what_affected / incurred_charges / customer_wants / exact product/order line
existing_representations.finding: Create/PATCH records Case intent and facts under Operation-or-Principal; editable text is not itself a typed Service Case Approver decision.

existing_representations.representation: evidence[] slot/path/kind + server at/by/by_role, private signed file reads
existing_representations.finding: Existing proof must be preserved/read. Upload actor/time proves an upload, not automatically the business approval expressed inside a file.

Seven admitted steps: inspect, supplier_date, collect, at_supplier, back_from_supplier, redeliver, customer_confirmed. Existing outcome/history evidence is not absent. No admitted formal-remedy approve/refuse step or Service Case Approver resolution was found in this producer.
SLA/deadline events and current Case timestamps are not by themselves scope-bound formal remedy approval.

Existing logistics/supplier instructions, warehouse notes, item/qty/PO reference and author/date are reusable evidence. They are not discarded. Current producer has no qualified formal-remedy approval field/door.

An existing general approval representation exists. Its current route is Principal-scoped and has no typed Service Case producer/consumer or bound Case remedy/version contract. Do not invent a Service-specific record merely because a separate table/UUID is absent.
The existing qualified authority should be reused; the catalogue entry alone is not an approved decision occurrence.

production_read_only_measurement.limits: TEST data under CLAUDE6, not business-volume evidence or a repair/backfill worklist. Exact-reference/payload-key scan is bounded and does NOT prove that no external/legacy written authorisation exists.

affected_subset.subset: Existing procurement-approved SC request with unchanged goods/qty/configuration/destination/recipient/source facts
affected_subset.treatment: Retain existing Purchasing approval/issue and fresh scope/coverage checks. Do not impose a new blanket Service gate or demand a nonexistent Decision UUID.

affected_subset.subset: A new or materially changed formal customer repair/replacement/charge/movement decision
affected_subset.treatment: Service MASTER7.4 requires its qualified Case approval before that decision is executed; do not infer it from customer_wants, carres_action text, evidence upload actor or Purchasing approval alone.

affected_subset.subset: Which current SC procurement operations constitute unchanged already-authorised follow-up versus execution of a new formal remedy
affected_subset.treatment: Current typed facts do not classify this reliably. Do not use purpose=service_case as an all-case denial predicate. No blanket SC-disabled implementation is being shipped as complete.

proposed_reuse_path.path: Preserve exact existing Case/order-line/action/evidence/progress/Service Note source links and current Purchasing-approved scope. Have the controller bind only the actually affected formal-remedy subset to a confirmed owning Case approval representation/read contract, reusing existing Case history/evidence and shared Duty. Existing procurement-authorised unchanged cases keep their purchasing path. No new Service implementation, roster, applicant acknowledgement or Decision-UUID requirement is commissioned here.
proposed_reuse_path.falsifier: A current governing file, Case progress/Service Note/generic approval producer, or observable source record demonstrates a qualified Service Case Approver decision with exact goods/remedy/scope, actor/time and unchanged-scope lineage; trace/reuse that representation instead of treating it missing.

draft_action: Removed the earlier overly broad purpose=service_case Stock/PO denial from the UNAPPLIED draft. Package remains NOT READY FOR PRODUCTION ACTIVATION; no production SQL/app/data changed.

purchasing_consumer_boundary.classification: READ CONTRACT DEPENDENCY; NO SERVICE MODULE BUILT
qualified_source_must_prove: Exact Case and goods/Units/quantity/configuration/remedy/movement and relevant policy/version
Existing Service Case Approver decision actor, time and actual approved outcome through the shared authority, with stable source identity
Current facts still within that approved scope; changed remedy, charge or scope uses its new governed decision; routine unchanged follow-up does not repeat approval
purchasing_consumer_boundary.do_not_require: A newly invented Decision UUID/table. Reuse any actual owning existing representation that proves the above; source identity need not be a UUID.
purchasing_consumer_boundary.current_purchasing_fact: _purchasing_request_context_state retains actual Case id/order/line/SKU/category/supplier/carres_action/what_affected/customer_wants/evidence and compares against saved Purchasing approval. Its service_case_source is scope-drift evidence only, not formal Service decision authority.
purchasing_consumer_boundary.local_controls: Existing SC procurement fixture captures actual Case facts, unchanged Purchasing scope stays readable, changed Case action invalidates saved scope, authorised unissued same-number repair retains old approval history. TEST text saying approved procurement scope does not manufacture a qualified Service remedy approval.
purchasing_consumer_boundary.activation_limit: No reliable typed producer currently classifies a new/changed formal remedy versus already-authorised unchanged follow-up. All new-context activation stays closed pending that owning read contract. No purpose=service_case blanket-denial predicate or applicant self-certified authorisation is added.
